contents.part: outer surface (vertices, triangles) and sharp edges, decimated
contents.crack: the line each side of the starting flaw grows from, then one entry per solved crack: size, nominal cycles counted from the first solved crack, largest K and each front as points with K_I, K_II, K_III
contents.growth: crack size against cycles for the nominal part
contents.life: share of parts failed against cycles from the Monte Carlo, with percentiles

summary.headline: A 1.27 mm through crack at the edge of the 8 mm hole at (91.7, -3.6, 2.5) fails after about 86,219 cycles in a typical part. One part in ten fails by 55,144 cycles and one in a hundred by 37,968. 68% of parts fail before the 100000 cycle target (allowed 1%).
summary.loading: constant amplitude between 0.1 and 1 of the load (R = 0.1)
summary.path_end: a step that could not be meshed or solved (gmsh could not mesh the part with the crack in it (_build took longer than 180 s)
